about_the_game:
Retro Chaos Reborn

BITCRUSHER is a retro pixel-art space shooter where the screen fills with asteroids, swarms of enemies, and big bad bosses. Every run throws you into fast, crunchy arcade action with escalating chaos and a pulse of nostalgia.

Build Your Perfect Ship

Collect weapons, abilities, and space junk to customize your ship. Mix and match loadouts to suit your style —whether you prefer raw firepower, clever utility, or survival-focused builds.

Face the Swarm

Enemies don’t wait their turn. Expect relentless waves, tricky patterns, and powerful bosses. The deeper you go, the stranger and more unpredictable the galaxy becomes.

Endless Replayability

Each run is different, with randomized challenges and unlocks that keep you coming back for “just one more try.” Master the chaos, climb the leaderboards, and push your skills to the limit.

The Corruption Awaits

Something unusual is spreading through the stars, twisting everything it touches. What it is — and how long you can last against it — is up to you to discover.
